standard.title: Active / Funded Account
standard.desc: Active savings account with ample balance.

min_balance.title: Min Balance Account (bal 1500, min 1000)
min_balance.desc: Only 500.00 withdrawable above the minimum balance.

not_found.title: Account Not in CBS
not_found.desc: Card linked to an account that does not exist.

expired_card.title: Expired Card
expired_card.desc: Card expiry (Track 2 / DE 14) in the past.

unknown_card.title: Unknown Card (valid BIN)
unknown_card.desc: BIN is ours but card is not issued.

invalid_bin.title: Invalid / Unallocated BIN
invalid_bin.desc: BIN not issued by the bank.

mismatch.title: Card / Account Mismatch (Tampering)
mismatch.desc: Valid card but DE 102 belongs to another customer.

testcases.name: Cash Withdrawal - Approved with Balance Debit Verification
testcases.description: Withdraw 500.00 and verify the account is debited by exactly 500.00 in DE 54.
testcases.expected_result: 0210 RC 00; available balance reduced by 500.00; DE 2/3/4/11/37/102 echoed.

testcases.name: Balance Enquiry - Approved with DE 54
testcases.description: Balance enquiry returns ledger and available balances.

testcases.name: Mini Statement - Approved with DE 63
testcases.description: Mini statement returns statement lines in DE 63.

testcases.name: POS Purchase - Approved with Balance Debit
testcases.description: Card-present POS purchase debits the account.
testcases.expected_result: 0210 RC 00; DE 48 retained; balance reduced by 2500.00.

testcases.name: E-Commerce Purchase - Approved with Balance Debit
testcases.expected_result: 0210 RC 00; balance reduced by 1500.00; reversal 00 / 09 (in progress).

testcases.name: Cash Withdrawal with Fee in DE 46 (Over Quota)
testcases.description: Interchange fee carried in DE 46 is passed through to CBS.

testcases.name: Minimum Balance Breach
testcases.expected_result: Declined 51 (would breach min balance 1000); balance unchanged.

testcases.name: Withdraw Exactly Down to Minimum Balance
Full Reversal (Timeout, Reason 68) Restores Balance
testcases.expected_result: 0430 RC 00; DE 90 echoed; balance fully restored.

testcases.name: Reversal Without Original Transaction
testcases.expected_result: Acknowledged / declined (25 / 21 / 00) with NO credit to the account.

testcases.name: Duplicate Reversal (Same 0420 Twice)
testcases.expected_result: Second reversal 94 / 00; account credited only once.

testcases.name: Reversal Amount Mismatch
testcases.expected_result: Mismatched reversal rejected; no credit until the correct reversal.

testcases.name: Reversal of a Declined Transaction
testcases.expected_result: 21 / 00 / 25 with NO credit to the account.

testcases.name: Duplicate 0200 (Identical Resend)
testcases.expected_result: Resend declined 94; account debited only once.

testcases.name: LLVAR Length Tampered (DE 2 prefix = 25)
testcases.expected_result: Format error 30 (or connection dropped) - never approved.

testcases.name: Card / Account Mismatch (Parameter Tampering)
testcases.description: DE 2 belongs to customer A but DE 102 is customer B's account.
testcases.expected_result: Declined - must never debit another customer's account.

testcases.name: CBS Late Response -> Switch Timeout -> Auto Reversal
testcases.description: Mock CBS: amount 68.00 posts then answers after 5 s. Real CBS: needs delay injection.
testcases.expected_result: Switch times out, reverses; account not debited in the end.

testcases.name: CBS Drops Connection -> Reversal
testcases.description: Mock CBS: amount 91.00 posts then closes the socket.
testcases.expected_result: No response; reversal restores the account.

testcases.name: CBS System Malfunction (96) -> Reversal
testcases.description: Mock CBS: amount 96.00 returns 96 without posting.
